scenes.line1: How do you catch slowdowns early?
scenes.say: Ever wonder how teams spot performance issues before code hits production? Why do we run performance tests in continuous integration pipelines?

scenes.label: Automation
scenes.sub: Automated tests catch regressions fast, before users notice.
scenes.say: Automating performance tests in CI means regressions get caught early, not after users complain.

rows.b: Run k6, fail if p95 latency high
Run JMeter, alert on error rate

scenes.say: You can use tools like GitHub Actions with k6, or Jenkins with JMeter. Set thresholds so builds fail if latency or error rates spike.

scenes.question: Why automate performance tests in CI?
scenes.right: So regressions are caught before production, not after.
scenes.say: Here's a common interview trap: Why automate performance tests in CI? It's not just for documentation—it's to catch regressions before they reach users.
